Lemma
[absolute volume comparison]

Source: petersen:page-0294 ↗ lem:pet-ch7-ricci-comparison-mean-curvature 1. ch7:7.1.3If $(M,g)$ has $\Ric \ge (n-1)k$, then $\vol B(p,r)\le v(n,k,r)$, where $v(n,k,r)$ is the volume of a metric ball of radius $r$ in the constant curvature space form $S^n_k$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch7-absolute-volume-comparison \sketch In polar coordinates, integrate $\lambda $ over the segment domain of $B(p,r)$. The pointwise bound $\lambda \le \lambda _k$ and extension of the nonnegative model density to the whole model ball give $\vol B(p,r)\le v(n,k,r)$.

□

The absolute estimate in subsection 1.2 strengthens to a monotonicity statement for ratios of volumes.
